positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:

•	Developed Node.js 3D file conversion server and improved server stability by implementing queue system and refactoring server code with MVC pattern

positions.title: Junior Technician
positions.description:
•	Managed, operated, and repaired the base’s intranet network infrastructure and provided LAN and desktop support
•	Trained new recruits on how to debug network errors and troubleshoot hardware related issues
•	Received a contribution award for actively investigating a Windows 7 authentication error and providing a solution by writing an authentication bash script

projects.title: Venture
projects.description:
Independently built a web application that provides a social platform where tourists can connect with local residents to explore cities without needing to reference online guides or tour agencies

Provides freelance tour guides with ability to easily create, edit, and delete custom tours. Tourists can also utilize search functionality to filter results.

Implemented with modern design to provide better interactivity and user experience

Built with Django web framework, designed with Bootstrap, CSS, and Jquery, and implemented with Python, HTML, and JavaScript

projects.title: Stock trend analysis graphing tool
projects.description: This is Graphing User Interface python program that analyse stock trend by graphing SMA/EMA/RSI/MACD. Currently analyses Google, Facebook, Apple, Tesla, and Yahoo. It has functionality to choose periods for EMA and SMA, also includes basic tutorial. Currently in development.
